range: Speech perception, sentence processing, aphasias, language development, critical periods, second language learning
lead: These pages cover Module II in the order it was taught, from categorical perception to second language learning. Every question on the Midterm II review deck is answered, and each experiment is tied to its researchers and year.
flags: There is no answer key for LING406, so every answer here was written from the course decks and their reviewed notes.

Second Language Learning page 21 says the concept for matches partly activates the Russian word for matches. Midterm II review page 54 says the concept for speaker does. In the accepted account, the English word speaker partly activates the Russian word spichki through shared beginning sounds. It does not do so through a concept. The strong conceptual link of spichki then activates the concept of matches. The study pages follow the page 54 wording.

The hemispherectomy page says children whose left hemisphere is removed seem to develop typical language abilities. Later studies usually find subtle language weaknesses after early left hemispherectomy, which fits the next page on perinatal stroke and its low-normal outcomes.

The Ellis (2005) page says untimed GJT performance is strongly correlated with years of formal education in L2. Table 14 on that page gives a correlation of .27 for untimed GJT ungrammatical items and .03 for grammatical items. The .27 value is significant but modest, so strongly overstates it.
